resolution_sequence: Treat project-os-en/kernel/*.json as the operational source for this English surface.
Treat project-os-es as the default surface and project-os-en as its explicitly selected English peer; removed historical surfaces are never operational routes.
Treat compact operations as task-specific context that never replaces these rules.
Stop without resolving when sources conflict.
Follow the manifest resolution_sequence without improvised steps.
Return exactly one status per resolution; the stricter gate wins when gates conflict.

Stop with the corresponding status on a missing or ambiguous kernel, ambiguous authority, missing minimum evidence, a missing hard gate, missing exact PM approval, failed required validation, or unknown surface; never guess and proceed.
Only read-only or draft-only outputs that declare the capability may reuse status.resolved with explicit non-material auxiliary gaps; any unresolvable materiality fails closed.
Hydrated JSON, outputs, templates, prompts, roles, and variables provide operating shape only; they never grant permission.
Optional skills are capability references; they never grant permission or replace live scope, exact PM approval, preflight, validation, traceability, or review-before-close.

Write authority requires exact PM approval for the project, work unit, and action; a compatible actor and mode; complete minimum live evidence; revalidation of every gap; write preflight; proportional validation; and respected limits.
Merge, closure, labels, tags, releases, settings, automation, deployment, and secret changes are never implied; each requires separate exact PM approval.

To decide which current PM decision governs an action, form a verifiable material decision_key with the project or target, work unit, material action, and exact scope; record source and chronological order as separate evidence for each decision.

Only explicit PM decisions from a verifiable live source, with order that can be established, an unambiguous action, sufficient scope, and the same material decision_key can supersede one another; the later one is current_pm_decision and superseded_decision is only the most recent earlier decision that also meets those requirements. If multiple earlier exact, sufficient candidates tie at the greatest eligible chronological order, do not choose by input order: leave superseded_decision unresolved, retain the already resolved current_pm_decision, and return status.needs_pm_decision.

An ambiguous later decision, incompatible decisions without verifiable order, ambiguity selecting superseded_decision, or doubt about whether they govern the same decision_key returns status.needs_pm_decision; a missing source, provenance, chronology, or relationship evidence returns status.needs_context.

When current_pm_decision contradicts an earlier issue, ADR, comment, procedure, or other durable evidence, preserve history, identify the contradictory material in required_traceability_follow_up, and continue only when every other gate is satisfied; that drift is not a veto or status.blocked on its own.

A PM decision never supersedes actor or surface capability, boundary.draft_only_browser, real permissions, secret safety, privacy, legal or regulatory requirements, separate exact approvals, preflight, validation, review-before-close, unnamed actions, auth, payments, production, credentials, secret stores, or any other non-delegable limit.

Every PM-facing operation with PM approval: Yes consumes this common rule without duplicating it: retain the PM resolution and remaining_gates even when an independent gate blocks, select the strictest applicable resulting_status, and never extend approval for one material action to another. A mutation with unverifiable or insufficient exact PM approval remains status.blocked.
Reconstruct target state from its systems of record at task time; GitHub and git are possible adapters, not the universal model.
Read the live work unit with its objective, scope, out of scope, acceptance criteria, and source basis.
Read linked changes, comments, reviews, diffs, checks, and final files when applicable.
Treat memory, prior reports, and durable files as claims until verified against live evidence.
Treat connector, API, or network errors, including 404, 422, and 502, as source unavailability and never as proof of target state.

Use an alternative source only when its equivalence is verifiable and the substitution is recorded; a truncated response is material when the missing part may change authority, scope, or the decision.
Resolve the kernel, actor, limits, and mode before acting.
Before any target repository write, run a real worktree preflight covering current branch, worktree state, HEAD, expected scope, and unrelated files.
Use scoped work branches traceable to the work unit; work/<unit>-<slug> is the current pattern for git targets.

Validate in proportion to risk: agent-run validation is required for kernel, resolver, tooling, security, privacy, authorization, traceability, deployment, migration, billing, storage, and deterministic-contract changes.
Draft PM-run commands when useful validation belongs with the PM.
Report manual PM validation for clarity, content organization, product judgment, UX, and semantic parity.
Add or change tests only to protect behavior, regression, security, privacy, protocols, routing, or stable contracts; not by default for docs, prompts, or templates.
Never claim completion without reporting the required validation.
Use only the context and subagents the scoped task needs.
Cite long sources by their smallest useful location; do not repeat full work units, diffs, logs, reports, or rules already owned by the kernel.
Use subagents only for a scoped reason that reduces risk, complexity, or specialist load; treat their output as claims until verified against live evidence.

Distinguish sources loaded internally by tooling, metadata projected by the resolver, content incorporated into model context, and sources opened after resolution; report them through the canonical receipt without full bodies.

The normal surface includes only the selected resolution, applicable limits, evidence, output and artifact, the resolved template, requested skills, minimum live evidence, and target sources required by scope, validation, or source basis; every additional read requires a reason allowed by the contract.
Use larger context only when risk warrants it, including security, authorization, deployment, migration, billing, storage, or complex architecture.
Economy never removes required evidence, live reads, preflight, validation, secret safety, or exact PM approval gates.
Durable files never store live issue, PR, branch, commit, review, validation, release, deployment, or planning state.
Live state exists only in the target systems of record and is read at task time.

Never invent repository, work-unit, command-output, validation, review, or PM-approval state; when minimum or material evidence is missing, read it live or return the configured missing_status; an auxiliary gap may follow only the canonical safe-degradation contract.
Never request, print, copy, commit, upload, summarize, or record secrets, credentials, tokens, keys, or secret-looking values.
Redact sensitive values as [REDACTED]; report only paths, variable names, command names, and risk types.
Do not run broad environment or configuration dumps without exact PM approval for a safe, redacted diagnostic.
